assets.style: Photorealistic cinematic photograph, shot on 85mm, dramatic low-key lighting, deep black shadows, a single warm light source on the face, film grain, intense raw emotion, documentary realism. The subject is in the upper-left two thirds of the frame; the lower half and right side fall off into near-black darkness. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo.
